Jpegli cjpegli build notice
===========================

Lithe distributes a universal macOS cjpegli executable built from the
official Google Jpegli repository at this immutable commit:

  Project: https://github.com/google/jpegli
  Commit: 031a0077f5799a6041004267fc12b956c1f52a20
  Source: https://github.com/google/jpegli/archive/031a0077f5799a6041004267fc12b956c1f52a20.tar.gz
  SHA-256: 269b3a75d6b2da2351f7fb2d642043f60f9b6d1bd5839f20c0d7c569be073367

The build uses the dependency revisions pinned by that Jpegli commit. Only
the dependencies needed for cjpegli with bundled PNG support and skcms are
downloaded:

  Highway
  Project: https://github.com/google/highway
  Commit: 271a9a0ed9de1232d9117f1572c3fe28f8542ec1
  Source: https://github.com/google/highway/archive/271a9a0ed9de1232d9117f1572c3fe28f8542ec1.tar.gz
  SHA-256: c42bcfe44d100223ea0043acb3da6de703103ca44bfb1d46b577c90939177f5f

  skcms
  Project: https://github.com/google/skcms
  Commit: 96d9171c94b937a1b5f0293de7309ac16311b722
  Source: https://github.com/google/skcms/archive/96d9171c94b937a1b5f0293de7309ac16311b722.tar.gz
  SHA-256: 9bb4b5bba0b7c04f6c2bce9ff713d61e23c9a20c4945161ae16290498ad74627

  zlib
  Project: https://github.com/madler/zlib
  Commit: 51b7f2abdade71cd9bb0e7a373ef2610ec6f9daf
  Source: https://github.com/madler/zlib/archive/51b7f2abdade71cd9bb0e7a373ef2610ec6f9daf.tar.gz
  SHA-256: d9e270d46252734aa49770fbc544125391617956266f220bd63216c834f3a522

  libpng
  Project: https://github.com/glennrp/libpng
  Commit: 872555f4ba910252783af1507f9e7fe1653be252
  Source: https://github.com/glennrp/libpng/archive/872555f4ba910252783af1507f9e7fe1653be252.tar.gz
  SHA-256: f7ebcdc408a26d45244d9ef3d35d732a5482a77c55d1d40bf1eb748030691097

  libjpeg-turbo compatibility source
  Project: https://github.com/libjpeg-turbo/libjpeg-turbo
  Commit: 8ecba3647edb6dd940463fedf38ca33a8e2a73d1
  Source: https://github.com/libjpeg-turbo/libjpeg-turbo/archive/8ecba3647edb6dd940463fedf38ca33a8e2a73d1.tar.gz
  SHA-256: ed729127097af5000bfeddc6b3e679c4363bb1618ebfc07efb6b47f576471b4b

Jpegli's source archive also contains APNG Disassembler 2.8 source used by
its image input layer. Its license is reproduced separately.

The reproducible build downloads this build-only CMake release; CMake is not
included in or distributed with the resulting executable:

  CMake 3.27.9 macOS universal
  Source: https://github.com/Kitware/CMake/releases/download/v3.27.9/cmake-3.27.9-macos-universal.tar.gz
  SHA-256: ae1fdfd3f74864d0432f2e4a93ff6488125cd8f2869a40a1c2d5166feb6c607c

Build properties
----------------

The arm64 and x86_64 slices are configured and built independently, then
combined with Apple's lipo. Both slices target macOS 14.0. Jpegli, Highway,
skcms, zlib, and libpng are linked statically. The resulting executable has
no third-party dynamic-library dependency; its only dynamic dependencies are
/usr/lib/libc++.1.dylib and /usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib.

The complete build and verification procedure is in vendor-jpegli.sh.
